Package hadur117.core.melee

Class AimExperts

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.melee.AimExperts
public final class AimExperts extends Object
TMODE-27, Ogi's danger model: the ways an enemy class may aim at a member, each weighted by how well it has called the bullets that hit the team.

Six experts: five simple aims (head-on, linear, circular, linear at the average velocity of the last AVERAGE_TICKS ticks, linear at half speed) and the team's learned aims (TeamDanger). When an enemy bullet hits a member, the member works out where each expert would have aimed at it when the shot was fired, and how far off each was in bot widths (errors(hadur117.core.world.EnemyShot, hadur117.core.model.RobotState, double[], double)); those errors travel with the hit's sample, so every member scores the experts on the whole team's hits. Each class's experts carry a decayed loss (DECAY a hit), and an expert's weight is exp(-ETA x loss): the aims that keep missing fade, the ones that keep hitting take the profile. Pooled by class (TeamModes.key(java.lang.String)), so every copy of an enemy teaches the rest.
